# Knowledge test fixtures — SYNTHETIC, NOT REAL LEGAL CONTENT

⚠️ **Nothing in this directory is real regulatory guidance and none of it may be
published, seeded into any environment, or shown to a founder.**

Every fixture uses the reserved agency name **"Example Regulatory Authority"** and
the reserved country code **`ZZ`**, neither of which exists. Any text resembling a
requirement is placeholder prose written for this test suite.

This matters more here than in most codebases. The Constitution forbids inventing
regulations, fees, agencies or citations, and a fixture that reads like a Bahamian
requirement is exactly the thing that ends up in a demo. Fixtures are therefore
implausible on purpose.

## Real Bahamian sources

**None have been ingested.** Authoritative sources will be selected with the founder
before any production Knowledge Pack content is created. The structure below shows
what a real source fixture will look like; the content is deliberately fake.

## Files

| File                  | Purpose                                                   |
| --------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `synthetic-source.ts` | A registration record + draft chunks that pass validation |
| `invalid-sources.ts`  | Registrations that must be rejected, one per K2 rule      |
